integrity: Analytic proof supplied; direct exact-rational chamber and witness checks provided. No independence or external certification claimed. Date 2006-12-14 is the verified initial public timestamp of the lead arXiv source; the earlier 2001 convex-blend paper has year/month-only bibliographic evidence here and its exact day is not inferred.
scientific_limitations: Exact result restricted to uniform centered three-point filters on real cycles of n>=6 with 0<=theta<=1. It does not assess statistical risk, shorter cycles, other windows or boundary conventions. Historical priority is subject to unindexed results and incomplete access to one differently specified 2014 hybrid-filter paper.
title: A sharp three-quarter mean-weight threshold for cyclic median blends
